observations: Three photos show a white console with a black vertical stripe, matching the design of a PlayStation 5 Slim Digital Edition.
Photo 0 and 1 show the console from a top-down angle, held by a hand. A white sticker with a barcode and price in USD ($40.95) is visible on the top left corner.

Photo 2 shows the console from a top-down angle on a wooden surface, with the front panel slightly open, revealing the disc slot area — but no disc drive is visible, consistent with a digital edition.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the top left of the console in all photos.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.
No power cord, controller, or other accessories are shown in any photo.
The sticker price is in USD, suggesting the item may be imported or resold from another country.

read_from: photo 0: PlayStation logo and slim design
photo 2: front panel design without disc drive, consistent with digital edition

claims.evidence: Photos show a console with the distinct design of the PS5 Slim Digital Edition, and the condition suggests prior use (e.g., sticker, minor wear).
